name: io.github.jayzht/memory3l-mcp
title: Memory and audit (memory3l)
description: Memory over MCP: an agent remembers across turns, and the store stays auditable.

environmentVariables.name: MEMORY3L_DB
environmentVariables.description: Path to the SQLite ledger served, and where memory is written.

environmentVariables.name: MEMORY3L_ALLOW_WRITE
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to expose the writing tools (remember, memory_context, append_facts). Without it the server only inspects memory.

environmentVariables.name: MEMORY3L_SUMMARIZER
environmentVariables.description: Model that compresses turns into summaries: auto, none (store verbatim -- no extraction, so the current-value registry stays empty), or deepseek/openai/ollama/heuristic.

environmentVariables.name: MEMORY3L_ROOT
environmentVariables.description: Override the location of the memory3l core (development against a source checkout).
